slides.texte_overlay:
How to never run out of things
to say with a girl you like
Ask about the last thing that made her laugh. It's light, it's personal, and it usually leads to a story you can both laugh about together for the rest of the evening.
Talk about places. Where she grew up, her favourite trip, where she dreams of going. Everyone has stories about places, and they're easy and fun to share together.
Build on details she gives you. She mentions her sister? Ask about her. A climbing class? Ask how she started. Every answer hides your next great question.
Bring new topics into your life. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and there's always a fun story or fact ready when the talk slows down.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. There's always a fun story or fact ready when the talk slows down.

slides.texte_overlay: Share your opinions, kindly. Favourite film, best pizza in town, pineapple or not. Friendly little debates create energy and make conversations really memorable.
Talk about the moment you're in. The music, the food, the people around you. Commenting on what you're both experiencing is the easiest topic in the world.
Don't fear a short silence. A smile and a sip of your drink are enough. Comfortable pauses mean you're relaxed together, and the next topic will come naturally.
